"""Session 09b acceptance measurements, at 1440x900 and 375x812."""

import json
import pathlib
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:18808"
SCRATCH = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
COVERAGE = json.loads((ROOT / "site/data/sample-coverage.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
USAGE_REAL = json.loads((ROOT / "site/data/usage-summary.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

REPORT = {}

def check_page(page, label):
    rep = {}
    rep["scrollWidth"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth]")
    rep["scrollWidth_overflow"] = rep["scrollWidth"][0] - rep["scrollWidth"][1]

    # every svg text element inside the radar container must fit in the container
    rep["radar_labels"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => {"
        "  const cont = document.getElementById('radar-chart');"
        "  if (!cont) return {error: 'no container'};"
        "  const cr = cont.getBoundingClientRect();"
        "  const bad = [];"
        "  cont.querySelectorAll('svg text').forEach(t => {"
        "    const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();"
        "    if (r.width === 0 && r.height === 0) return;"
        "    if (r.left < cr.left - 1 || r.right > cr.right + 1 || r.top < cr.top - 1 || r.bottom > cr.bottom + 1)"
        "      bad.push({text: t.textContent.slice(0, 30),"
        "                left: Math.round(r.left - cr.left), right: Math.round(cr.right - r.right),"
        "                top: Math.round(r.top - cr.top), bottom: Math.round(cr.bottom - r.bottom)});"
        "  });"
        "  return {count: cont.querySelectorAll('svg text').length, out_of_bounds: bad};"
        "}")

    # session table cells: '#' and duration columns must be single-line
    rep["session_cells"] = page.evaluate(
        "() => {"
        "  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#sessions-body tr');"
        "  const tall = [];"
        "  rows.forEach(tr => {"
        "    const cells = tr.querySelectorAll('td');"
        "    if (cells.length < 6) return;"
        "    [cells[0], cells[3], cells[4], cells[5]].forEach(td => {"
        "      if (td.offsetHeight > 45) tall.push({text: td.textContent.slice(0, 20), h: td.offsetHeight});"
        "    });"
        "  });"
        "  return {rows: rows.length, multi_line_cells: tall};"
        "}")

    # blind list top row matches the JSON (sorted by blind_spot_score desc, tie by topic_id)
    items = sorted(COVERAGE["items"],
                   key=lambda i: (-(i.get("blind_spot_score") if i.get("blind_spot_score") is not None else -1),
                                  i.get("topic_id") or ""))
    top = items[0]
    rep["blind_top_expected"] = {"name": top["topic_name"], "level": top["coverage_level"],
                                 "score": top["coverage_score"], "weight": top["exam_weight"]}
    first = page.locator("tr.row-main").first
    first.click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(250)
    rep["blind_top_row_text"] = first.inner_text()
    detail = page.locator("tr.row-detail:not([hidden])").first.inner_text()
    rep["blind_top_detail_has"] = {
        "reason": bool(top.get("reason")) and top["reason"][:20] in detail,
        "evidence_doc": (top.get("best_evidence") or {}).get("document_name", "") in detail,
        "question": any(f"第 {q['question_no']} 题" in detail for q in top.get("exam_questions") or []),
        "matched_terms": ("命中考点词" in detail) if any(
            q.get("matched_terms") for q in top.get("exam_questions") or []) else None,
    }
    # per-topic level and score in the table body
    body = page.locator("#blind-tbody").inner_text()
    rep["all_topics_present"] = all(it["topic_name"] in body for it in COVERAGE["items"])
    REPORT[label] = rep

def main() -> int:
    failed = []
    requests = []
    console_errors = []

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(channel="chrome", headless=True)

        for label, w, h in [("desktop_1440", 1440, 900), ("mobile_375", 375, 812)]:
            page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": w, "height": h})
            page.on("request", lambda r: requests.append(r.url))
            page.on("console", lambda m: console_errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
            page.on("pageerror", lambda e: console_errors.append(str(e)))
            page.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            check_page(page, label)

            rep = REPORT[label]
            if rep["scrollWidth_overflow"] > 0:
                failed.append(f"{label}: scrollWidth exceeds viewport by {rep['scrollWidth_overflow']}px")
            oob = rep["radar_labels"].get("out_of_bounds", [])
            if oob:
                failed.append(f"{label}: radar labels out of bounds: {oob}")
            tall = rep["session_cells"]["multi_line_cells"]
            if tall:
                failed.append(f"{label}: multi-line session cells: {tall}")
            if not rep["blind_top_detail_has"]["reason"]:
                failed.append(f"{label}: top blind detail missing reason")
            if not rep["blind_top_detail_has"]["evidence_doc"] and (REPORT[label]["blind_top_expected"]["level"] != "missing"):
                pass  # missing topics legitimately have no best_evidence
            if not rep["blind_top_detail_has"]["question"]:
                failed.append(f"{label}: top blind detail missing questions")
            if not rep["all_topics_present"]:
                failed.append(f"{label}: some topics missing from table")
            if label == "desktop_1440":
                page.screenshot(path=str(SCRATCH / "site-09b-desktop.png"), full_page=True)
            else:
                page.screenshot(path=str(SCRATCH / "site-09b-mobile.png"), full_page=True)
            page.close()

        # ---- video: default (missing) ----
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        disp = page.evaluate("() => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('demo-video')).display")
        pend_visible = page.locator("#video-pending").is_visible()
        REPORT["video_missing"] = {"display": disp, "placeholder_visible": pend_visible}
        if disp != "none" or not pend_visible:
            failed.append(f"video missing: display={disp}, placeholder visible={pend_visible}")

        # ---- video: mocked present ----
        page2 = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page2.route("**/media/demo.mp4", lambda r: r.fulfill(status=200, content_type="video/mp4", body="x"))
        page2.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page2.wait_for_timeout(800)
        disp2 = page2.evaluate("() => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('demo-video')).display")
        pend2 = page2.locator("#video-pending").is_visible()
        REPORT["video_present"] = {"display": disp2, "placeholder_visible": pend2}
        if disp2 == "none" or pend2:
            failed.append(f"video present: display={disp2}, placeholder visible={pend2}")
        page.close()
        page2.close()

        # ---- usage variants ----
        variants = {
            "only_site_stats": {"status": "ok", "site_stats": {"pv": 321, "uv": 88, "period": "10-29 至 11-10", "source": "Qoder Sites 访问统计"}},
            "only_usage": {"status": "ok", "usage": {"usage_days": 9, "study_sessions": 14, "questions_answered": 60, "total_minutes": 240, "source": "使用记录导出"}},
            "only_feedback": {"status": "ok", "feedback": [{"quote": "雷达指出的盲区和真实情况对得上。", "source": "用户反馈"}]},
        }
        for name, payload in variants.items():
            pg = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
            pg.route("**/data/usage-summary.json",
                     lambda r, body=json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False): r.fulfill(
                         status=200, content_type="application/json", body=body))
            pg.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
            pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
            blocks = pg.evaluate(
                "() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#usage-blocks .usage-block h3')).map(e => e.textContent)")
            collecting_visible = pg.locator("#usage-collecting").is_visible()
            REPORT[f"usage_{name}"] = {"blocks": blocks, "collecting_visible": collecting_visible}
            expected = {"only_site_stats": "Qoder Sites 访问统计", "only_usage": "使用记录汇总",
                        "only_feedback": "用户反馈"}[name]
            if blocks != [expected]:
                failed.append(f"usage {name}: blocks={blocks}, expected ['{expected}']")
            if collecting_visible:
                failed.append(f"usage {name}: collecting card still visible")
            pg.close()

        # ---- real file (collecting): no numbers shown ----
        page3 = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        page3.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        page3.wait_for_timeout(800)
        n_stats = page3.locator("#usage-filled .stat").count()
        collecting = page3.locator("#usage-collecting").is_visible()
        filled_hidden = page3.locator("#usage-filled").is_hidden()
        REPORT["usage_real"] = {"stat_count": n_stats, "collecting_visible": collecting,
                                "filled_hidden": filled_hidden, "file": USAGE_REAL}
        if n_stats or not collecting or not filled_hidden:
            failed.append(f"usage real file shows numbers: stats={n_stats}, collecting={collecting}")
        page3.close()

        # ---- mobile blind cards ----
        mob = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 375, "height": 812})
        mob.goto(BASE + "/", wait_until="networkidle")
        mob.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        cards = mob.locator(".blind-card").count()
        table_visible = mob.evaluate(
            "() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.blind-table-wrap')).display")
        mob.locator(".blind-card .bc-head").first.click()
        mob.wait_for_timeout(250)
        card_detail = mob.locator(".bc-detail:not([hidden])").first.inner_text()
        REPORT["mobile_cards"] = {"cards": cards, "table_display": table_visible,
                                  "detail_opens": "判定理由" in card_detail or "考点词" in card_detail}
        if cards != 10 or table_visible != "none":
            failed.append(f"mobile cards: count={cards}, table display={table_visible}")
        if not REPORT["mobile_cards"]["detail_opens"]:
            failed.append("mobile card detail did not open")
        # question content expand
        btn = mob.locator(".bc-detail:not([hidden]) .q-toggle").first
        if btn.count():
            short = mob.locator(".bc-detail:not([hidden]) .q-snippet").first.inner_text()
            btn.click()
            mob.wait_for_timeout(150)
            full = mob.locator(".bc-detail:not([hidden]) .q-snippet").first.inner_text()
            REPORT["question_expand"] = {"short_len": len(short), "full_len": len(full)}
            if len(full) <= len(short):
                failed.append("question content expand did not work")
        mob.close()
        browser.close()

    external = [u for u in requests if not u.startswith(BASE) and not u.startswith("data:")]
    real_errors = [e for e in console_errors if "404" not in e]
    REPORT["network"] = {"requests_total": len(requests), "external": external,
                         "console_errors": console_errors}
    if external:
        failed.append(f"external requests: {external}")
    if real_errors:
        failed.append(f"console errors beyond expected 404s: {real_errors}")

    print(json.dumps(REPORT, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print("\n".join("FAILED: " + f for f in failed) if failed else "ALL 09b CHECKS PASSED")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
